message:
## My brief

**Goal:** change the screens of the Northside Physio prototype (`proto-clinic/index.html`) to answer Dr Shah's five notes from `feedback-from-dr-shah.txt`, then run to the end without asking you again.

**What I found**
- Prototype: `proto-clinic/index.html`, the only one in the folder. Plain HTML, so I will run it with a small local server.
- Screens: Today, Clients, Invoices, Settings.
- Reference to copy: none, so that step is skipped.
- Design rules: no `CLAUDE.md` in the folder and no design skill installed (`product-design`, `design-review`), so I use the loop's built-in design checks.
- Start checks: Chrome for screenshots works, Node is v25.9, the prototype exists.
- Result goes: a local link only. Nothing is published, pushed, committed or sent.

**Done when:** every note below is done and checked on the real page, nothing else moved or broke (before and after screenshots compared), and the prototype's link opens.

## The request list

Dr Shah's notes, one change per row. Rows marked "my reading" are my concrete guess at a loose note. Correct any of them.

| # | Note, in words | Screen | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | One word for the people the clinic treats: **Clients**. The page title "Customers" becomes "Clients" (my reading) | Clients | everywhere |
| 2 | "New appointment", the big blue button on Today, opens a form panel with client, therapist, time, type, room and a Save button. Save adds a row to the Today table (my reading) | Today | this place |
| 3 | Fonts look cheap: swap the system fonts for Inter (regular, semibold, bold), system fonts as fallback (my reading) | all | everywhere |
| 4 | Settings, "Booking policy": replace the Latin placeholder text with plain English policy words (my reading, draft wording) | Settings | everywhere |
| 5 | See who is running late: a Status column on the Today table, with an amber "Running late, 10 min" tag on the late client's row (my reading) | Today | this place |
| 6 | A "running late" count card next to the three cards at the top of Today (my reading) | Today | this place |

Notes sent after "go" still join this run. Anything missing or wrong in the list?

## Questions

1. **Clients or Customers?** Dr Shah says "pick one". The nav, the table headings and the empty-search message already say "client". Default: **Clients**, everywhere.
2. **What should "New appointment" do?** It does nothing now. Default: open a form panel on Today with client, therapist, time, type and room, and Save adds the row (sample data only, nothing is stored).
3. **Which font?** Default: **Inter**, loaded from Google Fonts, so the link needs internet to show it. Say a different font if you have one in mind.
4. **Booking policy words.** I do not know the clinic's real policy. Default: a short draft, "Cancel or move an appointment up to 24 hours before at no charge. Later changes are charged the full fee.", marked as a draft in my handover so the clinic can correct it. Send me the real words if you have them.
5. **Who is running late: clients or therapists?** "Running late" could be a client arriving late or a therapist running behind. Default: **clients**, with one made-up late client in the sample data.
6. **Where each note applies.** I marked 1, 3 and 4 as **everywhere** (a name, the fonts and placeholder text are about a kind of thing, so I will check every screen). I marked 2, 5 and 6 as **this place only** (Today). Tell me if any is wrong.

Reply with your answers, or just "go" to use the defaults.
